lines.zh: 我在甲板上来回走，靴子早烂了。
lines.en: I pace the deck in boots that rotted off long ago.

lines.zh: 水从破布里挤出来，滴在船板上。
lines.en: Water squeezes from my rags and drips on the planks.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子走，鱼骨在腰间碰撞。
lines.en: I shuffle along, fish bones clacking at my waist.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩出湿印，像船在漏水。
lines.en: Each step leaves a wet print, as if the hull leaks.

lines.zh: 我沿着船舷走，手指划过朽木。
lines.en: I trail my hand along the rail of rotted wood.

lines.zh: 破布条挂在身上，走路时飘起来。
lines.en: My rags flutter as I walk, hanging in strips.

lines.zh: 我走向下个岗位，船上没有休息。
lines.en: I head for the next post; there is no rest aboard.

lines.zh: 脚踝以下全是水，我照样走。
lines.en: Water covers my ankles and I walk on anyway.

lines.zh: 我跟在同伴后面，一共七个人。
lines.en: I follow my crewmates, seven of us in all.

lines.zh: 我绕过主桅，那是船上最干的地方。
lines.en: I round the mainmast, the driest spot aboard.

lines.zh: 虚金在口袋里响，我可不敢丢。
lines.en: The void gold rattles in my pocket; I dare not lose it.

lines.zh: 我从船头走到船尾，海没有尽头。
lines.en: Bow to stern I walk, and the sea has no end.

lines.zh: 靴底打滑，我扶住缆绳站稳。
lines.en: My sole slips and I grab the rigging to stand.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，死人不需要赶路。
lines.en: I do not walk fast; the dead need not hurry.

lines.zh: 我走过破掉的舱门，跨了一下。
lines.en: I step over the broken cabin door.

lines.zh: 浪打上来，我脚下一个踉跄。
lines.en: A wave hits and I stumble a step.

lines.zh: 我靠在桅杆上，听船板吱呀作响。
lines.en: I lean on the mast and listen to the planks creak.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面，想不起自己怎么淹死的。
lines.en: I stare at the water, unable to recall my drowning.

lines.zh: 破布上的盐结成了白霜。
lines.en: Salt has crusted white on my rags.

lines.zh: 我把鱼骨摆成一条线，数了又数。
lines.en: I lay the fish bones in a row and count them again.

lines.zh: 海风穿过我的肋骨，吹出低音。
lines.en: Sea wind passes through my ribs and hums low.

lines.zh: 我试着回忆名字，只记得船名。
lines.en: I try to recall my name; I only remember the ship's.

lines.zh: 船上很安静，只有我在擦刀。
lines.en: The ship is quiet except for me wiping my blade.

lines.zh: 我听见船长在下面拖沉重的脚步。
lines.en: I hear the captain dragging heavy steps below.

lines.zh: 虚金在我手里忽冷忽热。
lines.en: The void gold in my hand runs cold, then hot.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的手，皮已经泡白了。
lines.en: I study my hands; the skin has soaked pale.

lines.zh: 有只海鸟落在桅顶，我没有赶它。
lines.en: A seabird lands on the masthead; I let it stay.

lines.zh: 我把破布拧了一遍，水还是滴。
lines.en: I wring out my rags and the water still drips.

lines.zh: 我数着潮声，一涨一落，又一涨。
lines.en: I count the tide, in and out, and in again.

lines.zh: 我想抽一口烟，肺里只剩海水。
lines.en: I want a smoke; my lungs hold only seawater.

lines.zh: 你站在甲板上，不像我们的人。
lines.en: You stand on the deck, and you are not one of us.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼白泡得发灰。
lines.en: I lift my eyes to you, grayed by the water.

lines.zh: 你身上没有盐味，我闻出来了。
lines.en: You carry no salt smell; I notice that.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，干的，很新。
lines.en: I stare at your boots: dry, and very new.

lines.zh: 你手里的剑不是弯刀，我看得清。
lines.en: Your sword is no cutlass; I can see that.

lines.zh: 我认出你是活人，所以我笑了。
lines.en: I recognize you as living, and that makes me smile.

lines.zh: 你后退半步，我却还在看你。
lines.en: You step back half a pace; I keep watching.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，脖子里的水响了一声。
lines.en: I tilt my head and water sloshes in my neck.

lines.zh: 我们船员名单里没有你这张脸。
lines.en: Your face is not on our crew list.

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，你怎么还不动。
lines.en: I have watched you a long while; why do you stand still?

lines.zh: 刀口不疼，只是又湿了一块。
lines.en: The cut does not hurt; it just adds more wet.

lines.zh: 我被打得后退，踩碎了鱼骨。
lines.en: The blow knocks me back and I crush my fish bones.

lines.zh: 我身上的破布又少了一条。
lines.en: Another strip of my rags is gone.

lines.zh: 你砍中我的肋骨，声音很脆。
lines.en: You hit my ribs and the sound is brittle.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口海水，不是血。
lines.en: I spit out seawater, not blood.

lines.zh: 疼得我记起了淹死那天。
lines.en: The pain takes me back to the day I drowned.

lines.zh: 我捂着腰，虚金掉了一地。
lines.en: I clutch my side and void gold scatters.

lines.zh: 你手真重，我站不太稳。
lines.en: Your arm is heavy; I cannot stand steady.

lines.zh: 我又死一次也不会更糟。
lines.en: Dying a second time cannot be much worse.

lines.zh: 这一下，让进度更近了一步。
lines.en: That one brings the advancement a step closer.

lines.zh: 你手里那条鱼，是给我们带的吗。
lines.en: Is that fish in your hand for us?

lines.zh: 鱼腥味飘过来，我的下巴动了。
lines.en: The smell of fish drifts over and my jaw moves.

lines.zh: 我跟着鱼走，忘了自己该站岗。
lines.en: I follow the fish and forget my post.

lines.zh: 生鱼就好，不用替我烤。
lines.en: Raw fish will do; do not bother cooking it.

lines.zh: 我把鱼骨留着，肉归别人。
lines.en: I keep the bones; the meat goes to the others.

lines.zh: 你晃那条鱼，我的膝盖就软了。
lines.en: You swing that fish and my knees go soft.

lines.zh: 我们船上三个月没见活鱼了。
lines.en: We have not seen fresh fish aboard in three months.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我只想闻一闻。
lines.en: I will not snatch it; I only want to smell it.

lines.zh: 这条鱼够我嚼一整晚的。
lines.en: This fish will keep me chewing all night.

lines.zh: 你举高一点，我够不着了。
lines.en: Hold it higher and I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的肩，海水溅了一地。
lines.en: You bump my shoulder and seawater splashes everywhere.

lines.zh: 我踉跄两步，鱼骨撒了出来。
lines.en: I stagger two steps and my fish bones spill out.

lines.zh: 别挤，甲板就这么宽。
lines.en: Do not shove; the deck is only so wide.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过，你闻到烂布味。
lines.en: We brush past and you smell the rotting cloth.

lines.zh: 我伸手扶你，手是凉的海水。
lines.en: I reach to steady you with a hand of cold seawater.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我听见骨头响。
lines.en: You step on my foot and I hear bone crack.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，给你让出缆绳。
lines.en: I step back half a pace to give you the rope.

lines.zh: 撞一下不疼，我早就没感觉了。
lines.en: A bump does not hurt; I stopped feeling long ago.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，破布挂住了你的扣子。
lines.en: We collide and my rag snags your button.

lines.zh: 你撞得我转了个圈，我还在笑。
lines.en: You spin me around and I am still grinning.

lines.zh: 她也是淹死的，我们谁也不提这事。
lines.en: She drowned too, and neither of us mentions it.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，两身破布一起滴水。
lines.en: We stand side by side, our rags dripping together.

lines.zh: 我替她理了理头巾上的海藻。
lines.en: I pick the seaweed from her headscarf.

lines.zh: 船上有伴，夜里的甲板没那么冷。
lines.en: With company aboard, the night deck feels less cold.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只把鱼骨分了一半。
lines.en: We say nothing; I just split the fish bones in half.

lines.zh: 她哼起船歌，我跟着打拍子。
lines.en: She hums a shanty and I keep time.

lines.zh: 两具尸体靠在一起，也算个家。
lines.en: Two corpses leaning together can count as a home.

lines.zh: 我答应她下次靠岸时一起下船。
lines.en: I promise her we will go ashore at the next port.

lines.zh: 她的弯刀和我的并排挂着。
lines.en: Her cutlass hangs beside mine.

lines.zh: 我们谁也没提反盗版那件事。
lines.en: Neither of us brings up that Anti-Piracy affair.

lines.zh: 地上有块虚金，我先捡了。
lines.en: There is void gold on the ground; I take it first.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡鱼骨，膝盖咔了一声。
lines.en: I bend for a fish bone and my knee clicks.

lines.zh: 破布我多得是，这块还是捡。
lines.en: I have plenty of rags, and I still pick this one up.

lines.zh: 谁掉的金币，归船上的公账。
lines.en: Whoever dropped this coin, it goes to the ship's fund.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的都塞进湿口袋。
lines.en: I stuff everything I find into my wet pockets.

lines.zh: 这东西沉，像装了一小块夜。
lines.en: This is heavy, like a piece of night inside.

lines.zh: 我捡起来又放下，它不该在这。
lines.en: I pick it up and put it down; it does not belong here.

lines.zh: 甲板上掉的，都是落水者的。
lines.en: Whatever falls on deck belonged to the drowned.

lines.zh: 我捡了块骨头，不知是谁的。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and cannot tell whose it was.

lines.zh: 落在水里的，我都当没看见。
lines.en: Anything that falls in the water, I pretend not to see.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，桅杆后面没用。
lines.en: I see you; hiding behind the mast will not help.

lines.zh: 有活人上船，全体都有活干了。
lines.en: A living one is aboard; we all have work now.

lines.zh: 我吹了声口哨，瞭望员会听见。
lines.en: I whistle once; the lookout will hear it.

lines.zh: 你踩响的那块板，整船都听见了。
lines.en: The plank you creaked was heard by the whole ship.

lines.zh: 我把刀从腰带上抽出来，很慢。
lines.en: I draw the blade from my belt, very slowly.

lines.zh: 别装作路过，你就是我要找的。
lines.en: Do not pretend to pass by; you are the one I want.

lines.zh: 我踢了踢同伴，他抬起头。
lines.en: I kick my crewmate and he lifts his head.

lines.zh: 生人的心跳，我在水里也听得见。
lines.en: I hear a living heartbeat even through water.

lines.zh: 你身上干得刺眼，我一眼就认出。
lines.en: You are painfully dry; I spot you at once.

lines.zh: 我从船头开始追，你跑不掉的。
lines.en: I start the chase from the bow; you will not escape.

lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近，刀尖朝下。
lines.en: I close in step by step, blade tip low.

lines.zh: 你退到船舷，后面是海。
lines.en: You back to the rail, and the sea is behind you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的喉咙，不眨眼。
lines.en: I fix on your throat and do not blink.

lines.zh: 我的同伴绕到你左边去了。
lines.en: My crewmate has circled to your left.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，你乱了。
lines.en: I count your steps, and they break rhythm.

lines.zh: 我贴着船板走，省得发出声。
lines.en: I move along the planks to keep from making noise.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就等你放下来。
lines.en: Raise your shield; I will wait until you lower it.

lines.zh: 甲板滑，我知道哪块板会响。
lines.en: The deck is slick, and I know which plank squeaks.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，湿脚印跟着我。
lines.en: I creep closer, wet footprints trailing me.

lines.zh: 你只有一个人，我们有七个。
lines.en: You are alone; there are seven of us.

lines.zh: 我一刀横过去，带着海水的重量。
lines.en: I swing across, seawater weight behind the blade.

lines.zh: 我的刀砍在你护甲上，火星溅开。
lines.en: My blade strikes your armor and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 你挡得住第一下，第三下呢。
lines.en: You block the first; what about the third?

lines.zh: 我扑上去，把湿冷压在你身上。
lines.en: I lunge and press my cold wet weight on you.

lines.zh: 这一刀是替淹死的同伴砍的。
lines.en: This cut is for the crewmate who drowned.

lines.zh: 我砍空了你，刀嵌进桅杆。
lines.en: I miss you and my blade sinks into the mast.

lines.zh: 你别躲，我手已经没力气了。
lines.en: Do not dodge; my arm is nearly spent.

lines.zh: 我的刀口卷了，照样能砸。
lines.en: My edge is dulled and it still crushes.

lines.zh: 我压上去，让你背贴着船舷。
lines.en: I press in until your back finds the rail.

lines.zh: 打完这刀，我又要回去站岗。
lines.en: After this swing I go back to my post.

lines.zh: 我从水下浮上来，先吐出海水。
lines.en: I surface from below and spit seawater first.

lines.zh: 船又靠岸了，我们跟着潮水来。
lines.en: The ship makes port again, and we come with the tide.

lines.zh: 我从浪里站起来，身上挂满海藻。
lines.en: I rise from the surf covered in kelp.

lines.zh: 破船搁浅了，我们从舱里爬出来。
lines.en: The wreck runs aground and we crawl from the hold.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，嘴里全是咸味。
lines.en: I open my eyes and my mouth is full of salt.

lines.zh: 新的一批船员醒了，我是其中之一。
lines.en: A new watch wakes, and I am one of them.

lines.zh: 我踩着湿沙上岸，脚陷进去半寸。
lines.en: I step onto wet sand and sink half an inch.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我们留在海滩上。
lines.en: The tide goes out and leaves us on the beach.

lines.zh: 我从木箱后面走出来，衣服还在滴。
lines.en: I step from behind a crate, still dripping.

lines.zh: 我们七个一起站起来，甲板晃了一下。
lines.en: The seven of us rise together and the deck tilts.

lines.zh: 火爬上我的湿布，冒着白汽。
lines.en: Fire climbs my wet rags, hissing white steam.

lines.zh: 我从舷梯滚下去，骨头散了一半。
lines.en: I tumble down the ladder and half my bones scatter.

lines.zh: 我又沉下去了，这次没人拉我。
lines.en: I sink again, and this time no one pulls me up.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到船外，破布着了。
lines.en: The blast throws me overboard, my rags alight.

lines.zh: 箭插在我肩上，像多长了根鱼骨。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder like an extra fish bone.

lines.zh: 那道光穿过我，水从我胸口漏出来。
lines.en: The light passes through me and water leaks from my chest.

lines.zh: 我早就不饿了，只是胃还在叫。
lines.en: I stopped being hungry long ago; my stomach still growls.

lines.zh: 雷火把我劈得跪在甲板上。
lines.en: The bolt drives me to my knees on the deck.

lines.zh: 船底就是虚空，我一脚踩空。
lines.en: Beneath the hull is the void, and I step through.
